events.x: The Inca Civil War, also known as the Inca Dynastic War, the Inca War of Succession, or, sometimes, the War of the Two Brothers, was fought between half-brothers Huáscar and Atahualpa, sons of Huayna Capac, over succession to the throne of the Inca Empire. The war followed Huayna Capac's death. Outcome: Reunion of the Inca Empire under the rule of Atahualpa; Execution of Huáscar; Starting of the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire. Cost: Dead: ~160,000 Ecuadorian Cañaris massacred; Death toll:; estimated 60,000 to 1,100,000 killed.
